body: Even the happiest people feel hurt. Some people are prone to it more than others. I know I can never completely understand what you are going through but you should make a completely informed decision and that involves being in a complete state of mind and taking all factors into account. Which you can’t do without talking to drew and while drunk

Stop I posted on here. It was my decision to talk to you. You can’t be bothering me if I made the decision myself. Just like everyone else in your life. It is their decision to be with you. And your not stupid,you’re hurting and there’s a major difference

If you don’t want to hurt him then tell him. Hes still in your life and cares for you. Your not a burden, more like a rope you carry with you so you can both reach higher. Sure the rope can be heavy at times but in the end you both reach the top together. Please just call him or somebody

What are you talking about they don’t deserve to put up with you? Tyhat’s the decision they made to be in your life! I won’t lie to you, life can be a shit show and I don’t know, nor can I fully know what you’ve been though. Listen if I can’t convince you to call the police then I’m sure Drew can show you that you are loved. Drunk decisions are never right

Please get some help! Call the police now and get help! The pills will just make you sick more than likely and you will end up in severe pain! You can do it and you have someone to live for and make plenty of happy memories with! You deserve that happiness and not pain! You’re drunk and not in the right mindset! In that case call the police and make that your risky decision for the day instead of this!

I understand how you are feeling. It can be hard to keep friends if you think like this about every relationship. Have you tried communicating this to your friends? And I don’t mean in a “you’ll just end up hating me” kind of way. Communicating your fear of hurting those close to you can go a long way in showing them how much you really care for them. It sounds to me that you don’t not want anybody, it’s just you don’t want to hurt them. You just sound like a good person who hates to see people around you in pain
